text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp is finally drawing to 
a close... All the academy students board 
the bus for the return trip.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, Cafe! Look, the seat next to 
me is wide open! It must have been hot 
outside, you must be terribly parched.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Today, I am the very embodiment of 
attentiveness! Go on, quench your thirst 
as you please! Come, chug it down, chug 
it!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Light O-san. Mind if I sit next to you?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: It's open. I don't mind!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
“Are you kidding me! Right next to Daitaku 
Helios?! Don't come crying to me if you 
end up totally rigid by the time we get 
off the bus! Hey—”

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Ha-ha, you got dumped!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Pokke-kun, if that's the case, then 
you—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Like hell I'll drink that, idiot! Hey, 
scooch over and gimme a seat!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, please don't get so close. Your body 
temperature is always bizarrely high, you 
know...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, everyone is so lively... ...Ah, 
Believe-chan.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Looks like that two-seater table over 
there is still open! Wanna sit together if 
you'd like?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...I don't mind, but...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I think I'll be sleeping the whole way 
back to the academy. Will that be all 
right?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! The summer training camp took 
a lot out of us after all~. I'm pretty 
sleepy myself...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Yes. And also—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
As soon as I get back, I'll start training 
for the Centaur Stakes. I want to recover 
my stamina beforehand.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Huh—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, the Centaur Stakes!? That race is 
next month, are you running in it!?"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Didn't you just run in the Kitakyushu 
Kinen the other day, Believe-chan...?"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I mean, isn't the main goal in the first 
place the Sprinters Stakes in late next 
month...?!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Next month is the Centaur Stakes 
right away, followed by the Sprinters 
Stakes later that same month.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: That is her scheduled race.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: D-Does that mean...—

text_block_list.name: Bus Driver
text_block_list.text:
Alriiiight, everyone please take your 
seats. We'll be departing soon~

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, I will take my leave now. —Good 
night.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah, good night... ......

As soon as we arrived at the academy, I 
called out to Believe. Even though I'd 
like to let her rest today after finishing 
the training camp, still—
choice_data_list:
Let's talk about what comes after 
tomorrow. You up for it?

Let's talk about what comes after 
tomorrow. Are you ready?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Yes. I'm all right.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Dants-san, I'll take my leave here.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Ah, u-um! See you later, Believe-chan—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Starting today, right now... we're really 
aiming for the Centaur Stakes..."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Believe-chan... Just how far will you—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...How much longer... must I—
